description: This file contains unit tests for the filterCardsAND function, which filters card objects based on multiple criteria such as assignee, priority, status, column, due date, and customer request status. The tests validate the filtering logic under various scenarios using mock data.

methods.name: filterCardsAND(cards, filters, columns)
methods.description: Filters a list of card objects based on multiple criteria provided in the filters parameter, including customer request status, assignees, priorities, statuses, columns, and due date range.
